description.value: Rocko's has been a Mission landmark since opening as the Hi-Lite Burger Bar in 1956, transitioning to its current identity in the 1980s and becoming the city's first 24-hour restaurant. Touring cyclists on the Lougheed Highway can count on round-the-clock home-style diner food — burgers, milkshakes, and hot dogs — in a classic roadside setting. The diner is also recognized as one of Canada's top 10 filming locations, having served as a backdrop for Riverdale and multiple Hallmark productions.
